scopeDefinitions.books: Unique official novels/Bachman novels/collections plus three separately published novellas. Four edition variants and six Green Mile serial publications are attached to their work and do not inflate the work count.
scopeDefinitions.stories: Unique official Short Story/Novella/Uncollected URLs, plus imported collection contributions; memberships are many-to-many. Dates are source-record dates, not automatically first publication.
scopeDefinitions.films: Official Movie/Television entities plus retained external adaptations and two sourced franchise additions. This is not an exhaustive derivative/short-film universe.
